mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the market discounts lower discount rates for equity valuations in a monetary easing environment.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS level and 20d SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the positive returns are not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05) compared to the baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases (i.e., when both decline, returns are positive in >50% of instances).

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in the federal funds rate predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the market anticipates monetary stimulus to support the economy.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 5.5, the FEDFUNDS decline fails to predict positive returns (Rank IC < 0.03 or t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Strong nonfarm payroll growth (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between PAYEMS growth and 20d SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the positive returns are not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05) compared to the baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 550.0 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 550.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates a broad economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and GDPC1 fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases (i.e., when both decline, returns are positive in >50% of instances) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales below 370,000 million dollars signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to immediate economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when RSAFS < 370000.0.
